title: Regression result contract
responsibility: Describe a committed regression result and its display in history.

outputs.name: regressionPhaseSchema
outputs.description: The zod enum of regression proof phases: red, green or capture.

outputs.name: regressionRecordSchema
outputs.description: The strict zod schema of a committed regression record: source commit, tree and parent SHAs, the tests, fixtures, runner configuration and lockfiles frozen at the failing commit, and the focused run's status, exit code and output log. It matters when a red, green or capture phase result is kept for history, and it never grants full verification or a budget baseline.

outputs.name: regressionViewSchema
outputs.description: The strict zod schema of one regression view: loop, units, a red point or null, an optional green point and an optional gap. Each point carries its commit, optional source tree and record id, status, command, assertion, output of at most 2,000,000 characters, finishedAt, and optional measurements and focused captures with their media or gap.

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: A value that regressionRecordSchema, regressionViewSchema or regressionPhaseSchema rejects, such as a missing required field, a commit or input hash that is not 40 lowercase hex characters, a record id or log hash that is not 64 lowercase hex characters, or a key the strict object does not declare. It matters because strict objects refuse unknown keys instead of stripping them, and nothing in these files catches or repairs the rejection.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: The ZodError thrown by `.parse()` on regressionRecordSchema, regressionViewSchema or regressionPhaseSchema when a value fails validation. These files never catch it, so it reaches the caller unchanged.
